channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo é o único presidenciável que não pontuou na nova pesquisa Genial/Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll tested nine presidential candidates for the 2026 elections in a first-round simulation, but only Aldo Rebelo, the Democracia Cristã pre-candidate, failed to register any score. The other candidates received measurable results, while the full article is available only to subscribers. This highlights Rebelo's current lack of visibility or support in early polling.

item.title: Moraes abre inquérito contra Flávio Bolsonaro por suposta calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized an investigation into Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for alleged slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, following a January 3, 2026 social media post accusing Lula of drug trafficking, money laundering, and other crimes. The April 13, 2026 ruling, responding to a Federal Police request and supported by the Attorney General’s Office, characterizes the post as slander with potential penalty enhancement due to its public dissemination via social media and targeting of the president.

item.title: Parecer que mirava ministros do STF é rejeitado; texto gera tensão institucional
item.description: The Organized Crime CPI rejected, by a vote of 6 to 4, the report by Senator Alessandro Vieira calling for the indictment of STF ministers Dias Toffoli, Alexandre de Moraes, and Gilmar Mendes, along with Attorney General Paulo Gonet, with possible referral for impeachment. The decision sparked institutional tension between the Legislative and Judicial branches, highlighting deep divisions over the independence of high authorities.

item.title: Juízes querem reduzir poder de CPIs e cassar quem critica o STF
item.description: STF judges expressed surprise at becoming targets of criticism during the 2026 election campaign, particularly after a Senate Organized Crime CPI report suggested indicting justices and the Attorney General in the Banco Master case. Gilmar Mendes labeled the report 'slander' and warned of an impending confrontation between the Court and efforts to limit congressional investigations, while Toffoli called for the electoral cancellation of Senator Alessandro Vieira for attacking the judiciary. The dispute highlights growing tensions between the Judiciary and Legislature amid allegations that CPIs are being weaponized for electoral gain.

item.title: Cresce a desaprovação de Lula entre os evangélicos, mostra Genial/Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows that disapproval of Lula's government among evangelicals rose from 61% in March to 68% in April, while approval dropped from 33% to 28%. This trend is seen as worrying for Lula's re-election bid, particularly in a key voter demographic.

item.title: Quaest: 43% temem volta da família Bolsonaro; 42% têm medo de Lula continuar no poder
item.description: The Quaest poll shows a technical tie between fear of Lula remaining in power (42%) and fear of the Bolsonaro family's return (43%), with 6% fearing both scenarios. In the first round, Lula leads with 37% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 32%; in the runoff, Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 42% against Lula's 40%. The margin of error is two percentage points.

item.title: Quaest: 52% desaprovam e 43% aprovam o governo Lula
item.description: The Quaest poll reveals 52% of Brazilians disapprove and 43% approve of President Lula’s government, with disapproval rising by 1 point since March. Among women, 49% disapprove and 45% approve, while disapproval reaches 56% among those aged 16–34. The Northeast remains Lula’s strongest region with 63% approval, while right-wing and Bolsonarist groups show overwhelming disapproval at 90% and 95%, respectively.

item.title: Deputado Mario Frias é internado após fortes dores abdominais
item.description: Federal deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP) was hospitalized on Tuesday in Brasília after experiencing severe abdominal pain. He was diagnosed with an abdominal blood vessel blockage and underwent a successful procedure to clear the obstruction. His team confirmed he is doing well, with no discharge date announced yet.

item.title: CPI rejeita indiciamento de Toffoli, Moraes e Gilmar
item.description: The Organized Crime Parliamentary Inquiry Commission (CPI) rejected the report by Senator Alessandro Vieira calling for the indictment of STF ministers Alexandre de Moraes, Dias Toffoli, Gilmar Mendes, and PGR Paulo Gonet, by a vote of 6 to 4. The rejection followed political negotiations involving the STF, Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, and the Lula government, which led to three changes in the CPI’s membership. Vieira argued that the Banco Master case involved sophisticated financial structures used to launder money for the PCC and facilitate corruption, calling it 'possibly the largest financial scandal in recent Brazilian history'.

item.title: Confiança no hexa despenca: só 29% dos brasileiros apostam na seleção às vésperas da Copa de 2026, aponta Datafolha
item.description: Brazilian confidence in winning a sixth World Cup has dropped to 29%, the lowest in nearly 30 years, according to Datafolha. France is seen as the main alternative at 17%, followed by Argentina and Germany at 4% each, with combined rival confidence (34%) exceeding Brazil's. Among men, France leads at 27%, while 36% of Lula voters still believe in the title.

item.title: Os recados de Lula a Motta durante almoço no Planalto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva met with Chamber President Hugo Motta at the Planalto Palace to request urgent constitutional processing of a bill ending the 6×1 work scale, tied to his labor history, and to suspend regulation of app-based delivery and ride-hailing workers due to ongoing disagreements. Motta said he would consult party leaders but prefers advancing the PEC on the same issue, while acknowledging the constitutional urgency of Lula’s request. The meeting, attended by new ministers José Guimarães and Paulo Pimenta, aims to prevent institutional friction following 2025 tensions between the branches of government.

item.title: TecnoGame traz edição histórica a Brasília entre 17 e 20 de abril
item.description: TecnoGame returns to Brasília from April 17–20, 2026, with a historic edition expected to draw over 30,000 attendees. The event will feature more than 35 national attractions, including eSports competitions, cosplay, K-pop, immersive experiences, and entrepreneurship and digital economy zones, supported by the DF’s Secretariat of Science, Technology and Innovation.

item.title: Câmara vota PEC da escala 6 X 1 após governo enviar PL com urgência
item.description: The Lula government sent a bill on workday reduction under urgent procedure to speed up voting, after including PEC 221/2019 in the CCJ agenda following a meeting with Chamber President Hugo Motta. The urgent bill has a 45-day voting deadline, with risk of blocking the chamber's agenda if not voted, while the PEC proceeds through normal channels. Lula prefers the bill due to greater control and veto power if Congress alters the proposal.

item.title: Petistas avaliam que Motta garantiu reeleição com vitória de Odair
item.description: PT leaders say Odair Cunha’s victory in the Tribunal de Contas da União was decisive in strengthening Hugo Motta’s re-election bid as Chamber president, as Motta’s support was key to the outcome. The result is seen as a significant political win for Motta, who secured the necessary backing to elect the PT lawmaker, with mutual support pledged for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Balança e pode cair esquema de Flávio Bolsonaro para eleição no Rio
item.description: Rio de Janeiro's acting governor, Judge Ricardo Couto, ordered a comprehensive audit of all state secretariats and agencies to verify the legality of direct contracts and suspend new tenders without proper budget allocation. The measure, prompted by warnings from STF ministers, aims to curb potential irregularities ahead of the October elections, directly impacting Bolsonarism, as former governor Cláudio Castro—an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro—faces political risk.

item.title: Caiado rebate Leite e diz não haver divisão no PSD
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado rebutted Eduardo Leite, stating there is no division in the PSD after the Rio Grande do Sul governor said his support for Caiado's pre-candidacy was not an 'automatic alignment'. Caiado described Leite's comment as a 'different' way of addressing political issues, affirming the party's internal choice was respected following Ratinho Junior's withdrawal. Leite continued to criticize Caiado's proposed amnesty for January 8 defendants, saying he disagrees with the PSD's decision, despite recent conciliatory gestures.

item.title: Por que investigação contra Lulinha no STF ainda não avançou
item.description: The Federal Police broke the banking, fiscal, and telematic secrecy of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the eldest son of President Lula, in January 2024, by order of Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. Despite this measure, investigations against him have not advanced and remain stalled or in early stages. The article is subscriber-only and does not explain the reasons for the lack of progress.

item.title: Motta mantém calendário da PEC da escala 6 X 1 após PL de Lula
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta maintained the schedule for the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale, despite the government's submission of a bill on the same topic. The decision followed a meeting with President Lula, who framed the bill as symbolic. Congress has 45 days to vote on the bill; if not passed, it will block the chamber's agenda until resolved.

item.title: Enquanto tenta reduzir endividamento das famílias, governo quer oferecer crédito para empresas investirem
item.description: The Lula government is finalizing a household debt renegotiation program and preparing new credit lines for business investment to stimulate the economy in an election year. The initiative aims to reduce family indebtedness while encouraging productive investment.

item.title: Lula 'nunca' relatou incômodo com fila do INSS, diz presidente demitido do órgão, que relata desavença com ministro
item.description: The former president of Brazil's Social Security Institute (INSS), Gilberto Waller, stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva never expressed to him any discomfort with the backlog of benefit applications at the agency, which has long been congested and cited as the reason for Waller's dismissal less than a year after his appointment. Waller, dismissed this week, also mentioned having disagreements with the minister overseeing the portfolio, though he did not name the minister directly.

item.title: Choque entre Poderes: como foi a reação coordenada para enterrar parecer de CPI que indiciou ministros do STF e PGR
item.description: The final report of the Organized Crime CPI, signed by Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE), recommended the indictment of three STF ministers and the PGR over alleged involvement in the Master case, but was rejected 6-4 following coordinated action by the Planalto, Centrão, and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The unprecedented report did not name any other individuals linked to the Daniel Vorcaro bank scandal or organized crime itself.

item.title: CPI do Crime Organizado: mais um round entre Congresso e Supremo - O Assunto #1701
item.description: The Organized Crime Parliamentary Inquiry Commission (CPI) rejected its final report, which sought the indictment of three Supreme Court justices (Alexandre de Moraes, Dias Toffoli, Gilmar Mendes) and the Attorney General, Paulo Gonet. Senator Alessandro Vieira, the commission's rapporteur, accused the Planalto Palace of direct interference in the report's rejection, escalating tensions between Congress and the Judiciary. The episode was discussed on the 'O Assunto' podcast with commentator Valdo Cruz, analyzing the political fallout in Brasília.

item.title: Governo Lula suspendeu concessão de BPC por quase seis meses em 2025 e represou 740 mil pedidos
item.description: The Lula government suspended new applications for the Continuous Benefit (BPC) for nearly six months in 2025, holding up 740,000 requests from low-income elderly and people with disabilities. The measure, revealed in documents obtained by Folha de S.Paulo, drew criticism for impacting one of Brazil’s key social assistance programs.

item.title: Lula pede a Galípolo que esclareça caso do Banco Master
item.description: President Lula asked Central Bank President Gabriel Galípolo to publicly clarify the Banco Master case by presenting a factual timeline without assigning blame. He noted that the bank’s authorization request was denied in February 2019 under Ilan Goldfajn and approved in September 2019 under Roberto Campos Neto, suggesting the issue originated in the previous administration. Lula also cited Deputy Paulo Pimenta’s role in a parliamentary inquiry, where he presented a chronological account of the case.

item.title: Lula recebe centrais sindicais no Palácio do Planalto um dia depois de propor fim da escala 6x1
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva meets this Wednesday with trade union centrals (CUT, CTB and Força Sindical) at the Palácio do Planalto to discuss the government's bill to end the 6x1 work schedule, reducing working hours without salary cuts. The bill, sent to Congress with urgency, seeks legislative support after recent tensions and conflicting statements about its submission. The meeting occurs in a pre-election context, with the government aiming to frame the proposal as a key social flagship, despite risks of overlap with a constitutional amendment (PEC) also under debate that addresses working hour reduction.

item.title: 6x1: governo apresenta projeto que reduz limite de jornada de trabalho semanal para 40 horas e prevê dois dias de descanso; veja detalhes
item.description: The Lula government has sent a bill to Congress proposing to reduce the weekly work limit from 44 to 40 hours, replacing the 6x1 work schedule with a 5x2 model featuring two paid rest days. The proposal, submitted under constitutional urgency, aims to modernize labor laws and benefit approximately 14 million workers, particularly in domestic and service sectors. It allows flexibility through collective bargaining and retains exceptions like the 12x36 schedule, provided the weekly average of 40 hours is maintained.

item.title: Grupo de ministros do STF vê risco de pauta anti-Corte dominar campanha eleitoral
item.description: A group of Supreme Court ministers warns that the Court risks becoming a central target in the 2026 electoral campaign, particularly following backlash to the Organized Crime CPI report and the Master case. They criticize public statements by President Edson Fachin and Minister Cármen Lúcia, arguing these increase the Court’s vulnerability to political exploitation. Internal tensions have risen after Fachin denounced the CPI’s attempt to indict ministers and Cármen advocated for transparency, while allies of Alexandre de Moraes link his image to the case involving his wife and banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: entenda os próximos passos de projeto de Lula e como fica a PEC de Erika Hilton
item.description: President Lula sent a bill to Congress to end the 6x1 work schedule, reducing the weekly workload to 40 hours without salary cuts, with constitutional urgency. The proposal is an alternative to the PEC by Congresswoman Erika Hilton (PSOL-SP), which seeks a 36-hour week and is under review in the Chamber’s CCJ. The government estimates a 4.7% cost increase with no economic disruption, while Chamber President Hugo Motta confirmed the PEC’s timeline remains unchanged.

item.title: Orçamento 2027: governo apresenta diretrizes hoje e prevê contas no azul, com economia de 0,5% do PIB
item.description: The government presented the 2027 Budget Guidelines Bill (PLDO), projecting a primary surplus of 0.5% of GDP, up from 0.25% expected for 2026. The proposal factors in rising oil revenues from the pre-salt and estimates social security spending at R$ 1.156 trillion, with a minimum wage of R$ 1,717. Despite expected improvements, structural fiscal challenges persist due to budget rigidity.

item.title: Um dia após Lula enviar novo projeto, comissão da Câmara insiste em votar hoje PEC do fim da escala 6x1
item.description: The Lula government submitted an alternative bill to end the 6x1 work scale, but the Chamber’s CCJ proceeds with voting on the PEC by Erika Hilton and Reginaldo Lopes today at 10 a.m., limited to constitutionality review. Despite the executive proposal, Chamber leaders signal maintenance of the schedule, with a special committee on merits possible if admissibility is approved. Datafolha poll shows 71% of Brazilians support ending the 6x1 workweek.

item.title: Escala 6x1: PL de Lula prevê jornada máxima de 40h por semana e 8h por dia
item.description: The federal government has sent to Congress a bill proposing the end of the 6×1 work schedule, reducing the weekly work limit from 44 to 40 hours and the daily limit to up to 8 hours, without salary reduction. The measure includes two consecutive weekly rest periods of 24 hours, preferably on weekends, with flexibility in essential sectors and retention of differentiated schedules like 12×36, as long as the weekly 40-hour cap is respected. The bill amends 10 laws, including the CLT, and aims to standardize rules across various professional categories.

item.title: Relator de CPI diz que ministros do STF não são donos do país e prevê maturidade para investigar
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE), rapporteur of the Organized Crime Parliamentary Inquiry Committee, stated that STF ministers are not the owners of the country and that the court's criticisms of the investigations constitute threats and attempts at intimidation. He advocated for institutional maturity to proceed with the inquiries, including the potential indictment of justices.

item.title: O que prevê projeto para fim da escala 6x1 que governo Lula mandou para o Congresso
item.description: The Lula government sent a bill to Congress to end the 6x1 work schedule, reduce the weekly workload from 44 to 40 hours, guarantee two paid days off, and prohibit any salary reduction. The proposal also amends the CLT and specific laws to ensure nationwide uniform application. Lula stated the measure aims to improve workers' quality of life by giving them more time for family, leisure, and rest.

item.title: Ministra do TSE pede vista e volta a adiar julgamento que pode tornar ex-governador de RR inelegível
item.description: Minister Estela Aranha of the TSE requested a view, postponing for the third time the trial that could remove Governor Edilson Damião from office and make former Governor Antonio Denarium ineligible. The current vote stands at 2-1 in favor of removing Damião and 3 votes supporting Denarium's ineligibility, with votes already cast by Maria Isabel Galotti, André Mendonça and Nunes Marques. The case concerns allegations of abuse of power and improper use of public resources during the 2022 Roraima elections, including the distribution of basic food baskets and housing repair benefits during a legally prohibited period.

item.title: Pedido de vista suspende julgamento sobre cassação da chapa eleita para o governo de RR em 2022
item.description: The TSE suspended the judgment on the possible cassation of the 2022 elected ticket for Roraima's government after a view request by Minister Estela Aranha. The TRE-RR had convicted Governor Antonio Denarium and Vice Governor Edilson Damião for political and economic abuse of power, declaring them ineligible and ordering new elections. Minister Nunes Marques presented a view vote favoring Damião's acquittal and Denarium's ineligibility, rejecting the possibility of a supplementary election.

item.title: Quem é o novo ministro do TCU eleito pela Câmara dos Deputados
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies elected Deputy Odair Cunha (PT-MG) as minister of the Federal Court of Accounts (TCU) with 303 votes, replacing Aroldo Cedraz. He received support from a coalition including PT, MDB, PDT, PCdoB, PSB, and Republicanos, and his nomination will now be reviewed by the Senate in a secret vote. In his speech, Cunha argued the TCU should act as a 'beacon of good management,' guiding and preventing errors in public administration without blocking policies.

item.title: Relator da indicação de Messias ao STF apresenta parecer favorável e abre caminho a AGU de Lula
item.description: The rapporteur for Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF in the Senate, Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA), issued a favorable opinion on the nominee chosen by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, paving the way for AGU approval and advancing the nomination toward Senate hearings.

item.title: Após avisar Motta, Lula envia projeto de fim da escala 6×1 para o Congresso
item.description: Hours after having lunch with House Speaker Hugo Motta, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva sent to Congress a bill proposing the end of the 6×1 work schedule. The text is already on the list of proposals under constitutional urgency, which could block the legislative agenda if not voted on within 45 days. The initiative aims to speed up the discussion, either through this bill or the PEC already underway in the Chamber.

item.title: Governo Lula encaminha ao Congresso projeto de lei para o fim da escala 6×1
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has sent to Congress a bill with constitutional urgency to end the 6×1 work schedule and reduce the weekly workweek to 40 hours without salary reduction. The proposal aims to give workers more time for family, leisure, and rest, but faces opposition from the Centrão and other political groups, with a vote expected in late April and skepticism about its approval in May.

item.title: Ministros Nunes Marques e André Mendonça são eleitos presidente e vice do TSE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) elected Minister Nunes Marques as president and Minister André Mendonça as vice-president on Tuesday, the 14th. The vote was conducted via electronic ballot, resulting in 6 votes to 1 in favor of Nunes Marques, and the newly elected officials will lead the TSE during the 2026 General Elections. Outgoing President Minister Cármen Lúcia emphasized the candidates' experience and the need for continuity in electoral justice ahead of the upcoming vote.

item.title: Motta reclama de Boulos durante encontro com Lula
item.description: Chamber of Deputies President Hugo Motta complained to President Lula during a Tuesday meeting about Minister Guilherme Boulos's 'belligerent' stance against the legislature. Motta argued that Boulos lacks support even within his own party, PSOL, and that his actions harm government management.

item.title: Lula tem o dobro de apoio entre idosos do que junto aos mais jovens, aponta Datafolha
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll shows that President Lula's government approval among seniors (60+) is double that of young adults (16-24): 36% rate it as 'excellent and good' among the elderly, compared to 18% among youth. Nationally, negative perception of the government remains stable at 40%, while Lula's personal disapproval rose to 51%. The survey, conducted April 7-9 with 2,004 respondents, has a 5-point margin of error.

item.title: Em vitória de Lula e Motta, Câmara aprova Odair Cunha para o TCU
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies elected Odair Cunha (PT-MG) as the new minister of the TCU with 303 votes, defeating Elmar Nascimento (União Brasil-BA), who received 96 votes. The vote was secret and involved five candidates, with the PL withdrawing Soraya Santos’ candidacy to rally support behind Elmar Nascimento in an effort to unite opposition to the PT’s nominee. Odair Cunha, a six-term deputy with a reputation for political moderation and articulation, will now have his name forwarded to the Senate as a PDL for final approval.

item.title: TSE suspende julgamento de governador de Roraima com placar de 2 a 1 por cassação
item.description: The TSE has again suspended the trial that could remove Roraima Governor Edilson Damião from office and render former Governor Antonio Denarium ineligible, following a request for vista by Minister Estela Aranha. So far, the vote stands 3-0 in favor of convicting Denarium and 2-1 for removing Damião, with Minister Nunes Marques voting to acquit Damião, citing institutional stability concerns and the risk of having five different governors in a short span. The case stems from allegations of political and economic abuse in the 2022 elections, and a ruling against Damião could trigger supplementary elections in Roraima later this year.

item.title: Relator apresenta parecer favorável à indicação de Messias ao STF
item.description: Senator Weverton (PDT-MA), rapporteur for Jorge Messias’ nomination to the STF, issued a favorable opinion, citing constitutional criteria such as impeccable reputation and notable legal expertise. The report emphasizes Messias’ experience at the Attorney General’s Office and his conciliatory profile, concluding there are no technical impediments to approval. The confirmation hearing is scheduled for April 29 in the Senate’s CCJ.

item.title: Senador apresenta relatório favorável a indicação de Messias para o STF
item.description: Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA), rapporteur for Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, presented a favorable report on Tuesday, to be read in the CCJ on Wednesday and voted in the plenary on the 29th. Messias, current AGU minister, was nominated by Lula last November, facing opposition from Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who preferred Rodrigo Pacheco. Despite the initial deadlock, the government secured sufficient support for approval, with both votes being secret and requiring at least 41 favorable votes out of 81 senators.

item.title: “Governo atravessou a rua para proteger ministros”, diz Alessandro Vieira
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE), rapporteur of the Organized Crime CPI, accused the federal government of interfering in the final vote on the committee's report, stating that the last-minute inclusion of two PT senators changed the commission's composition and secured the rejection of the document calling for the indictment of three STF ministers and the Attorney General. Vieira argued the change was decisive for the 6-4 vote against the report and maintained that the report's technical content remains valid despite the political outcome.

item.title: TSE volta a suspender julgamento sobre Roraima após voto de Nunes Marques contra novas eleições
item.description: The TSE again suspended the trial on the possible removal of Roraima Governor Edilson Damião after a dissenting vote by Minister Nunes Marques, who supported the ineligibility of former Governor Antonio Denarium but advocated for keeping Damião in office to prevent institutional instability. Marques warned that Damião’s removal could trigger up to five governor changes in six months, undermining governability. He also argued Damião was not directly involved in the alleged misconduct and that the case should not automatically penalize the ticket absent direct impact on election fairness.

item.title: Bancada do PT apresenta projeto que proíbe bets em todo o país
item.description: Pedro Uczai, leader of the PT caucus in the Chamber of Deputies, introduced Bill 1808/2026, proposing a total ban on fixed-odds betting in Brazil, covering both digital and physical operations, advertising, sponsorships, and financial transactions, while repealing existing laws that regulate the sector. Backed by President Lula’s statements, the initiative aims to protect the population from the social, economic, and health impacts of betting, including household debt and strain on the SUS.

item.title: Nunes Marques é o primeiro ministro indicado por Bolsonaro a assumir o TSE
item.description: Kássio Nunes Marques was elected president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) on Tuesday night (April 14), becoming the first minister appointed by Jair Bolsonaro to assume the position. He and his vice-president, André Mendonça, are set to take office in the first half of May, following the early departure of Minister Cármen Lúcia. Nunes Marques pledged a more measured, less interventionist approach focused on electoral serenity in 2026, contrasting with the 2022 clashes between Bolsonaro and then-TSE president Alexandre de Moraes.
